name: Crowned Pig
brief: A lovable plump PINK PIG wearing a prominent GOLD CROWN with three broad points and one red square jewel, a playful Minecraft king-pig homage interpreted as an original rounded cartoon pet. Large gently square-rounded head, broad cuboid pink snout with two nostrils, floppy triangular ears, four stubby dark brown hooves, little curly tail. A short rich red royal cape with cream trim attached at the shoulders. Friendly confident smile. Crown securely sitting on the head; no pixel art, no writing, no tools.
collision: Visual meshes non-colliding; use simple game-owned collision proxy
outline: Navy geometry seams; Roblox Highlight with FillTransparency=1 and Occluded depth for silhouette
